source.quote: FiiO's own parameters page, read 2026-11-24. « Maximum supported sampling rate / Hardware solution »: « DAC: ES9038PRO*2, USB: XMOS XUF208, Bluetooth: QCC5124, LPF: OPA1612 * 2, volume IC: NJU72315 * 2, AMP: THX AAA 788+ * 2, linear transformer：THAILIN/BingZi ». Rate rows: « 384kHz-32bit/DSD256（USB DAC） »; « 192kHz-24bit (coaxial) »; « 96KHz-24bit (optical) ». No digital-filter row: the « LPF: OPA1612 * 2 » entry is a hardware list item and the page never calls it a digital filter. Nothing about R2R, ladder or delta-sigma.

facts.chip: Two ES9038PRO (ESS), XMOS XUF208 as USB receiver, QCC5124 for Bluetooth. « LPF: OPA1612 * 2 » is the ANALOGUE low-pass stage and « volume IC: NJU72315 * 2 » the attenuator - neither is the converter.
